note: Warm plain text for empty, error and success states, greetings and quiet days. Najwa can edit.

morning: Good morning, you are here and that is enough
afternoon: Hope today is kind to you
night: Take a breath, it is late
Still up? You are not alone

quiet_day: It is quiet today. A good time to write something, or just rest.

empty.feed: Nothing here yet. Be the first to say hello.
empty.search: We could not find that. Try another word.
empty.saved: Nothing saved yet. Tap the bookmark on a post you want to keep.
empty.my_posts: You have not posted yet. Whenever you are ready.
empty.activity: No news yet. We will tell you when someone replies.
empty.connect: No one here yet. Turn on Open to chat in Me so others can find you.

errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side, not yours. Please try again.
errors.offline: No internet right now. You can still read the Care tab and help lines.
errors.post_failed: We could not post that. Your words are still here, please try again.
errors.wait_a_minute: You posted a moment ago. Please wait a minute, then try again.

success.posted: Thank you for sharing. You are not alone.
success.reported: Thank you. We will look at it.
